MTS-02.generation_rule: strictly monotonic within one mining session
MTS-02.late_event_rule: event generation must equal the current non-invalidated generation

MTS-03.current: observed height equals work parent height and tip_hash equals previous_hash
MTS-03.stale_chain_advanced: observed height is greater than work parent height
MTS-03.stale_parent_replaced: observed height equals work parent height and tip_hash differs
MTS-03.unknown_observer_behind: observed height is lower than work parent height
